notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (tabulated scene/condition and control variables in master.csv; no RESULT lines). Final script: pooled OLS LPMs via fixest::feols, Punishment ~ Child*VH on Violation and Violation+Help scenes (n=400/399), Helping ~ Child*VH on Help and Violation+Help scenes (n=401/400), VH = ViolationHelp dummy, controls male (Male Target), hugo (Male Actor, inferred from Table 2 coefficient pattern / variable role), Morning, witness, rich, Rain, Hot; SEs clustered by School (30 clusters). The one missing-gender target is dropped by listwise deletion in the controlled models. The estimates matched every Table 2 coefficient, N and R2 at reported precision, so no claim-driven revisions were made.
